name: 코렐라인

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 출시 실험체: 이세계의 잔영

visual_review: 흑백 비대칭 머리·청보라 눈·거울 장식과 드레스를 유지했습니다. 손 들어 거울 열기·반쯤 진입·거울 속 윤곽·출현·강화 공격·회수의 이동 동작이 확인됩니다.
motion_summary: Coraline two-tone black/white hair, blue-violet eyes, black-white/pink elaborate dress and dark angular purple mirror ornaments from portrait. Official R moves through mirror world untargetably then returns with an empowered attack. Animate idle; hand raises a thin mirror shard; leaning forward; vertical violet-edged oval mirror portal opens immediately to right; stepping through with half her body vanishing; only thin fragmented reflected outline in mirror; exits a short distance right with hair and skirt trailing; arm reaches forward firing one concentrated pink-white empowered arcana ray; torso recoil; turns and mirror shards return; lowers hand; exact original idle. Actual foot step/body translation and emerging pose, not only fading sprite. Preserve asymmetrical hair and eyes, no generic extra girl reflection or scenery. Small mirror opening, effects stay under 78% cell footprint.
